**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem or workflow bottleneck is (e.g. "I'm always frustrated when...").

**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen (e.g. new caption preset style, subtitle language support, custom outro generator).

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**Target User Persona**
- [ ] Church Media Team / Ministry Volunteer
- [ ] Podcaster / Long-Form Interviewer
- [ ] Educator / Online Teacher
- [ ] Content Creator / Video Editor

**Additional context**
Add any other context, visual mockups, or examples of existing tools or shorts here.
